name: Useberry
description_en:
Useberry supports prototype and website research, multiple unmoderated methods, live interviews and participant recruitment.

Its current plans meter responses, seats, interviews, transcription and uploaded recordings separately, so a research team should map an actual study workflow to all of those allowances.
description_zh:
Useberry 支持原型和网站研究、多种无主持方法、实时访谈及参与者招募。

当前套餐分别计算回答、席位、访谈、转录和上传录像额度，团队需要将实际研究流程对应到全部限制。

core_features.explanation_en: The prototype page describes Figma/ProtoPie/Sketch connections, workspace assets and single-task, first-click, free-navigation and other methods.
core_features.explanation_zh: 原型页描述 Figma/ProtoPie/Sketch 连接、工作区素材，以及单任务、首次点击、自由浏览等方法。

core_features.explanation_en: The product documents recordings, highlights, tags, click tracking and user flows alongside study results.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品记录录像、重点片段、标签、点击追踪和用户路径，并与研究结果结合。

core_features.name_en: Different recruitment providers by study type
core_features.name_zh: 按研究类型使用不同招募来源
core_features.explanation_en: The current pool page names Prolific for unmoderated studies and Respondent for moderated interviews; self-recruitment is also available.
core_features.explanation_zh: 当前人群页将无主持研究对应 Prolific、主持访谈对应 Respondent，另提供自招募。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free 10 responses/month. Annual Growth EUR 83 monthly equivalent/300 responses/one seat/five interviews; Business EUR 659/2,000 responses/five seats/50 interviews. Transcription, storage and recruitment are separate. Published paid-account freeze/no automatic Free terms and AI availability require confirmation.

Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Keep the imported prototype and research task aligned
sections.title_zh: 让导入原型与研究任务保持一致
sections.en:
Useberry’s prototype page describes connecting Figma, ProtoPie, Sketch and other design sources, keeping designs in sync and reusing prototypes, websites and images in a workspace library. It offers single-task testing, open navigation, first-click, five-second, preference and other methods. The homepage also lists card sorting, tree testing, surveys and randomized variants, plus live interviews and website testing.

For a hypothetical checkout redesign, define one task and completion condition, select a stable prototype version, then examine path, missteps and follow-up responses together. A linked design can change during data collection; record the version or preserve a reference before interpreting differences as participant behavior. Prototype success does not validate a live payment flow, backend or assistive-technology support. No import, website snippet or participant study was executed.
sections.zh:
Useberry 原型页描述连接 Figma、ProtoPie、Sketch 等设计来源，保持设计同步，并在工作区素材库复用原型、网站和图片。它提供单任务、自由浏览、首次点击、五秒、偏好等方法；首页还列出卡片分类、树测试、问卷和随机变体，以及实时访谈、网站测试。

以结账改版为假设，应定义一个任务及完成条件、选择稳定原型版本，再结合路径、错误和追问回答分析。链接设计可能在收集数据期间变化，解释差异为参与者行为前应记录版本或保存参照。原型成功不验证线上支付、后端或辅助技术支持。本研究未执行导入、网站脚本或参与者研究。

sections.title_en: Responses, interviews and storage are separate meters
sections.title_zh: 回答、访谈和存储分别计量
sections.en:
Free lists 10 responsesper month, one project, three versions per project, five blocks and one included seat, with additional seats up to 20 mentioned separately. Growth is listed at EUR 83 per month billed yearly with 300 monthly responses, one seat, unlimited projects/versions/blocks, five interviews monthly, ten transcription hours and 20 GB uploaded-recording storage. Business is EUR 659 monthly equivalent billed yearly with 2,000 responses, five seats,50 interviews,30 transcription hours and 500 GB storage. Extra response/seat capacity can be purchased within the shown limits.

Enterprise is custom and lists annual response capacity and larger seat/interview/storage allowances. These are displayed base configurations, not final customized invoices or prices for participants. The Business card marks AI-powered features coming soon, while Enterprise lists an AI add-on; current availability needs confirmation. Do not combine interview count, transcription hours and storage into a single assumption of unlimited recorded research.
sections.zh:
Free 列出每月十个回答、一个项目、每项目三个版本、五个模块和一个包含席位，另外提及可增加至 20 席。Growth 年付折合每月 EUR83，提供每月 300 回答、一席、无限项目/版本/模块、每月五次访谈、十小时转录和 20 GB 上传录像空间。Business 年付折合每月 EUR659，提供 2,000 回答、五席、50 次访谈、30 小时转录和 500 GB。可在所示上限内另购回答/席位。

Enterprise 定制，列出年度回答容量及更多席位/访谈/空间。这些是展示的基础配置，不是最终定制发票或参与者价格。Business 卡片将 AI 标为即将推出，Enterprise 列出 AI 附加包，当前可用性需确认。不能将访谈数、转录时数和空间合并理解为无限录像研究。

sections.title_en: Choose a pool that matches the session format
sections.title_zh: 按会话形式选择招募来源
sections.en:
The current Participant Pool page distinguishes unmoderated recruitment powered by Prolific from moderated recruitment powered by Respondent. It describes audience filters and screeners, while self-recruitment lets teams distribute a study link to their own audience. Provider pool sizes, geographic coverage and speed are marketing claims and do not guarantee that a particular specialist audience will fill.

A response allowance is capacity to collect results, not a quotation for recruiting and compensating every respondent. The actual recruitment price, incentives, no-show/replacement rules and screening incidence were not established on the read pool page. Confirm them for the selected method and audience instead of importing Prolific’s direct platform fee or Respondent’s independent prices into a Useberry order. No participant order or cross-provider handoff was tested.
sections.zh:
当前 Participant Pool 页区分由 Prolific 支持的无主持招募，以及由 Respondent 支持的主持招募，并描述人群筛选和筛选题。自招募则让团队向自有人群分发研究链接。提供方人群规模、地域和速度是营销声明，不保证特定专业人群能招满。

回答额度是收集结果的容量，不是招募和补偿所有回答者的报价。已读人群页未建立实际招募价格、激励、缺席/替换规则和筛选符合比例。应按方法及人群确认，不能将直接使用 Prolific 的平台费或 Respondent 独立报价套入 Useberry 订单。未测试参与者订单或跨提供方交接。

sections.title_en: Make a finding traceable without oversharing recordings
sections.title_zh: 让发现可追溯，同时控制录像分享
sections.en:
Useberry documents recordings, highlights, tags, click tracking and user flows, plus sharing study/results links and interview scheduling connections. Use a clip and task context to support a finding, then check whether the participant’s response or path contradicts the summary. Quantitative task completion and qualitative explanation answer different parts of the research question.

The terms place study design, tester criteria, rights to study materials and legal/ethical notices on the client. A recording can contain unrelated screen information; decide what is necessary, inform participants and inspect workspace/link permissions before distribution. The reviewed sources do not establish current AI training behavior, exact recording residency, redaction completeness or complete subprocessor routing. No participant-facing consent, role setup, calendar integration or sharing permission was tested.
sections.zh:
Useberry 文档列出录像、重点片段、标签、点击追踪和用户路径，以及研究/结果链接分享及访谈排期连接。发现应由片段和任务上下文支持，再检查参与者回答或路径是否反驳摘要。定量任务完成与定性解释回答研究问题的不同部分。

条款将研究设计、测试者条件、材料权利和法律/伦理通知责任交给客户。录像可能包含无关屏幕信息，应决定必要范围、告知参与者，并在分发前检查工作区/链接权限。已读来源没有建立当前 AI 训练、录像具体地域、遮盖完整性或完整分处理路径。未测试参与者同意、角色设置、日历集成或分享权限。

sections.title_en: Plan the exit before paying for a long term
sections.en:
The published terms say plans renew automatically for the same term unless nonrenewal is requested through the account, and subscription fees are generally nonrefundable. They also say a paid user cannot simply revert to Free: on nonrenewal the account enters a frozen state without access to stored information, services or remaining credits. The terms describe reactivation by buying a plan, with information retained for two years in the frozen state and deletion possible thereafter. That differs from assuming cancellation leaves an active limited Free workspace.

Account closure is a separate path: the terms direct users to download feedback/results before deletion and say content cannot be retrieved afterward. Confirm how these published clauses apply to the current plan, then export required research evidence before canceling or closing. No nonrenewal, freeze, recovery, deletion or invoice was tested. The prototype, interview and recruitment capabilities remain documentation-reviewed, not operationally validated.
sections.zh:
已发布条款说，除通过账户申请不续期外，套餐按相同期限自动续费，订阅费通常不可退。条款还说付费用户不能直接退回 Free：不续费后账户进入冻结状态，无法访问存储信息、服务或剩余点数。条款描述可通过重新购买套餐激活，冻结信息保留两年，之后可能删除。这与“取消后仍有可用的有限 Free 工作区”不同。

关闭账户是另一路径：条款要求删除前下载反馈/结果，并说删除后无法恢复。应确认这些公开条款如何适用于当前套餐，在取消或关闭前导出所需研究证据。本研究未测试不续费、冻结、恢复、删除或发票，原型、访谈和招募能力仅完成文档核对，未操作验证。

research_gaps.en: Confirm response counting, add-on prices, paid recruitment/incentives, AI availability and applicability of paid-account freeze terms.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认回答计数、附加包价格、付费招募/激励、AI 可用性及付费账户冻结条款适用性。

research_gaps.en: No prototype/live-site study, participant order, calendar connection, recording, export, permissions, cancellation or deletion was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行原型/网站研究、参与者订单、日历连接、录像、导出、权限、取消或删除测试。
